EmailTemplate.name: Application Validated Under Review
EmailTemplate.subject: [{!Account.WCF_Organizational_Name__c}] Application validated — under review
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Account.FirstName},
Good news — your application for {!Account.WCF_Organizational_Name__c} has passed our initial validation and is now with our review team for assessment.
This stage typically takes a couple of weeks. There’s nothing you need to do for now. We’ll contact you as soon as there’s an update or if we need anything further.
View your application status: https://wadhwanifoundation--wfdev.sandbox.my.site.com/wcf/s/applicant-portal
Warm regards, The Wadhwani Grants Team
Wadhwani Grants — the grant-making arm of the Wadhwani Foundation.
